<document id=DOC_release_note>
Release 4.2 closes three reported defects. The importer no longer
drops a trailing column when a file ends without a newline. The
scheduler retries a failed job twice before reporting it. The audit
log records the account that performed a deletion.
</document>

Summarise the release note below.

Return your answer as a JSON object with exactly two keys: "summary", a
string, and "areas", an array of strings. Return nothing outside the JSON
object.

response.text: {"summary":"Release 4.2 fixes three defects: the importer keeps a trailing column when a file has no final newline, the scheduler retries a failed job twice before reporting it, and the audit log records which account performed a deletion.","areas":["importer","scheduler","audit log"]}
